newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Great Eagle buys Canada hotel - paper.
newsitem.headline: Great Eagle buys Canada hotel - paper.

text.p: Hong Kong property group Great Eagle Holdings Ltd has spent HK$712 million (US$92 million) for a hotel in Canada, a Hong Kong newspaper reported on Saturday.
The acquisition of the four-star Delta Chelsea Inn in Toronto was the second in a month for the Hong Kong-based company, Chinese-language Ming Pao newspaper said.
Great Eagle purchased a hotel complex in Melbourne, Australia, from insurer Transport Accident Commission (TAC) for A$119 million two weeks ago.
Officials from Great Eagle were not immediately available for comment.
Delta Chelsea, located in downtown Toronto, has 1,594 rooms, the newspaper said.
